result.title: Insane AI Breakthroughs Nobody Is Talking About
result.description:
12 AI breakthroughs you probably missed, from incredibly human AI voices to a walking robot powered by an old phone.

These are some of the coolest AI tools, research projects, and tech demos I’ve come across recently that didn’t make it into my weekly AI news videos. We’re looking at AI characters that react to your movements, interactive world models, new ways to edit videos, and voice AI that invents an entire life for itself.

I test several of these tools, explore what you can actually try today, and point out where the demos still fall short. Plus, glasses that claim to understand silent speech, NVIDIA’s AI character animation, and robots learning to move at human speed.

Which of these would you want to try first? Let me know in the comments.
